load_mtl: load material properties and texture images from an .mtl file given material names and data directory
make_mesh_texture_atlas: build a per-face texture atlas from material properties, texture images, and UV coordinates for a mesh
make_material_atlas: create a per-face texture map from a single texture image and face vertex UV coordinates using barycentric interpolation
parse_mtl: parse an .mtl file to extract material properties and texture file references into dictionaries
load_texture_images: load texture images for referenced materials from disk and return material properties alongside image tensors
